family.description: This family includes lipoprotein GfcB (YmcC), involved in group 4 capsule polysaccharide formation [[cite:PUB00066719]]. YjbF is a family of Gram-negative bacterial outer-membrane lipoproteins, predicted to be a beta-barrel and possibly a porin that is one of four gene-products expressed from an operon, yjbEFGH, which is regulated by the Rcs phosphorelay in a RcsA-dependent manner, similar to that of other exopolysaccharide biosynthetic pathways. It is highly possible that the yjbEFGH operon encodes a system involved in EPS secretion since none of the products is predicted to have enzymic activity, the products are all secreted and YbjF and H are predicted to be beta-barrel lipoproteins similar to porins. It may be that the operon products play some role in biofilm formation and/or matrix production [[cite:PUB00066719]].
family.name: Group 4 capsule polysaccharide lipoprotein gfcB, YjbF
